mapper.select: select * from official_broadcast where id = #{broadcastId} for update
select b.* from official_broadcast b where b.status = 1 and (b.scheduled_time is null or b.scheduled_time <= now()) order by b.id
select * from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} order by member_id, id
select * from official_broadcast_log where id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into official_broadcast_log (broadcast_id, member_id, role, channel, reached, clicked, create_time, delivery_state, delivery_title, delivery_sub) values (#{broadcastId}, #{memberId}, #{role}, #{channel}, 0, 0, now(), 'PENDING', #{deliveryTitle}, #{deliverySub})
mapper.update: update official_broadcast_log set delivery_state = #{state}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, message_id = #{messageId}, reached = case when #{state} = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end, reached_time = case when #{state} = 'SUCCESS' then now() else null end where id = #{id} and delivery_state = #{expected}
mapper.select: select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and (delivery_state is null or delivery_state != 'SUCCESS')
select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and channel = 'inapp' and reached = 1 and delivery_state in ('SUCCESS', 'INAPP_STORED')

select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and ((reached = 1 and delivery_state in ('SUCCESS', 'INAPP_STORED')) or (channel = 'subscribe' and delivery_state = 'CHANNEL_ACCEPTED'))
select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and channel = 'inapp' and clicked = 1 and reached = 1 and delivery_state in ('SUCCESS', 'INAPP_STORED')

select count(1) from official_broadcast_log where member_id = #{memberId} and channel = 'inapp' and reached = 1 and delivery_state in ('SUCCESS', 'INAPP_STORED') and coalesce(reached_time, create_time) >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
mapper.insert: insert ignore into official_broadcast_log (broadcast_id, member_id, role, channel, reached, clicked, create_time) values (#{broadcastId}, #{memberId}, #{role}, #{channel}, #{reached}0, 0, now())
mapper.update: update official_broadcast_log set reached = 1 where broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} and member_id = #{memberId} and channel = #{channel}
mapper.select: select id,member_id,role,channel,delivery_state,frozen_title,frozen_sub,intent_id,message_id,attempts from official_broadcast_log where broadcast_id=#{broadcastId} order by id
select * from official_broadcast_log where id=#{id} for update
mapper.update: update official_broadcast_log set delivery_state=#{state},intent_id=#{intent},message_id=#{message},attempts=attempts+#{attempt},update_time=now(3),reached=case when #{state}='INAPP_STORED' then 1 else 0 end,reached_time=case when #{state}='INAPP_STORED' then now() else null end where id=#{id}
